question: Related Questions Q. Is it allowed for a women to call her husband by his name? Is it better not too? What is the daleel/proof for this? 5701 views Q. I'm in the midst of serious family problem. My father (70 years) and mother (55 years) have been married for 28 years. I'm the eldest son, 27 years with 2 sisters and 1 younger brother. My parterns very often fight with each other since our childhood. All the time abusing each other. This reached it peak when six months ago my father accused my mother of adultery out of anger. My mother was about to commit suicide. My father goes to the houses of all our relatives and tell them false stories of how bad our mother is. My mother is in serious depression. Now my sister is about to be married. But my father still behaves like that. Now my mother asks me and my younger brother to hold our fathers neck and ask him to stop his misdeeds. On the other hand my father always abuses my mother everyday. I know both are at fault but most of the time its my father who has not control on his anger and make a bigg issue out of nothing an starts abusing my mother. They dont want to sit down and and solve the problem. Always the fights are on petty issues. We cannot tolerate this any more. Please tell us what we children, especially the sons do in case the parents behave like this. 2354 views Q. I have heard that parents have 14 rights over their son/daughter 3581 views Q. I have seen two of my friends(male) are very close..at the time of sleeping some time they share one bed .. many time one boy completely covering other boy from his back side and sleeping..is it allowed ...what is the level of friendship among two youths..which is allowed between two friends and which is not allowed ? whether two youth can sleep together in one bed if both have no bad intension..is it allowed in islam 1967 views Q. Assalamualaikum, Dear Sir, with due respect i wanted to ask you that leaving parents behind for the sake of better career is rightful or not? Note that the parents both are healthy, managing their financial status by themselves in a good way, other younger brothers still living with them, also they are showing complete happiness about the situation, my point is that one always know that parents are never happy at heart for leaving the kids stay away from them (even if they have many) but always are happy as they want their kids to grow & propser. JAZAKALLAH' KHAIR. Wassalam 11574 views
answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 16475 Country: Pakistan Title: Salam I need to know being internal auditor i have to forward the department weakness to managment for control and on some occasion update the managment about the working of individual staff on specific occasion. I need to know whether it come under the ambit of gibbat or not? Question: Salam I need to know being internal auditor i have to forward the department weakness to managment for control and on some occasion update the managment about the working of individual staff on specific occasion. I need to know whether it come under the ambit of gibbat or not? Answer ID: 16475 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1659/1507/B=1430) No, it does not come under ghibah (backbiting) rather it is a kind of correction. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
